title: Connect your AI assistant to the Gorgias MCP
snippet:
The Gorgias Model Context Protocol (MCP) app allows your third-party AI assistant to access your Gorgias data and account, so it can read and analyze your helpdesk tickets, and audit and update your Gorgias settings.
The instructions in this article outline how to connect the Gorgias MCP app to Claude, but you can connect it to any MCP-compatible AI client, including [Cursor](https://cursor.com/docs/mcp), [ChatGPT](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-developer-mode-and-mcp-apps-in-chatgpt), and more. Refer to your AI client's documentation for how to add an HTTP MCP server, then authenticate with Gorgias when prompted.
**Note:** The Gorgias MCP is currently in beta, and some features may not work as expected.
---
### Requirements
- Available on all [Helpdesk plans](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing)
- [Everyone](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/user-permissions-196938) can install the Gorgias MCP. The actions available to you depend on your Gorgias role.
- An account with an MCP-compatible AI assistant app (for example, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.)

On Free, Pro, and Max Claude plans, you can add the Gorgias connector directly from your Claude Desktop settings. On Team and Enterprise plans, connectors are managed at the organization level — an Owner must add the Gorgias connector first, then members can connect individually. Once you've authenticated, your credentials are saved automatically for future sessions.
Before you start the installation, make sure you have all of the following:
- **Your Gorgias subdomain**. Your subdomain is the `your-brand` part of your account URL (`your-brand.gorgias.com`).
- **The [Claude Desktop app](https://claude.ai/download)** installed on your computer, and signed into your Claude account.
**Note:** For the most up-to-date guidance on adding a connector to Claude, we recommend reviewing [their documentation](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp).
### Connect to Free, Pro, and Max plans
1. Open the Claude desktop app, then select **Customize**.
2. Click **Connectors**, then click **+ Add** and select **Add custom connector**.
3. In the **Name** field, enter **Gorgias connector**.
4. In the **Remote MCP server URL** field, enter the following URL: [https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp](https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp)
5. Click **Add**.
6. Click **Connect**. You'll be redirected to the browser.
7. Enter your Gorgias subdomain, then click **Continue**.
8. Click **Allow

title: How to Use Claude or ChatGPT with Gorgias
snippet:
- **Compatible AI tools:** Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any other MCP-compatible client
- **Cost:** Included in your existing Gorgias paid plan at no extra cost.
- **AI Agent:** Not required. Helpdesk-only customers have full access.
- **Availability:** Currently in open beta, open to all paid plan customers.

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables AI systems to link directly with other tools.
The Gorgias MCP provides a first-party bridge, giving you a secure, direct connection between your chosen AI assistant and your Gorgias account.
Once connected, your LLM of choice can:
- Read and search your tickets and customer history
- Analyze patterns across CSAT scores, [ticket volume](https://www.gorgias.com/blog/ticket-volume), and resolution time
- Review your macros, rules, and tags
- Audit your AI Agent guidances and handoff tickets
- Draft new AI Agent guidances based on your existing setup
- Check user permissions and team configuration

**What you need:**
- A Gorgias paid plan (any plan, AI Agent not required)
- An active subscription to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another MCP-compatible tool
**Steps:**
1. Open your AI tool and navigate to its settings. Look for an Integrations, Connectors, or MCP section.
2. Add a new MCP server using this endpoint: **mcp.gorgias.com/mcp?gorgias_subdomain=YOUR-SUBDOMAIN**. Replace **YOUR-SUBDOMAIN** with the part of your Gorgias URL that comes before .gorgias.com.
3. Authorize the connection via OAuth. You will be prompted to log into your Gorgias account.
4. Open a new chat and ask your first question.

Gorgias MCP is currently in open beta and available to all paid plan customers.

Gorgias MCP is a separate connection layer that lets you operate your Gorgias account from an external AI tool like Claude or ChatGPT. The two work alongside each other: for example, you can use Gorgias MCP to audit and improve your AI Agent's guidances and settings from inside your AI assistant.

title: Gorgias MCP Server
snippet:
Model Context Protocol server for Gorgias.
This URL hosts an MCP endpoint, not a website. To use it, point an MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.) at:
```
https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp
```
On first connect you'll be asked which Gorgias account to authorize. You can also skip that step by appending `?gorgias_subdomain=<your-subdomain>` — the part before `.gorgias.com` in your Gorgias account URL.

snippet:

snippet:

**Gorgias MCP is in open beta today**, a first-party server that plugs your workspace into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible tool.
## **What you can do with it:**
- **Voice of Customer insights.** Uncover frustration patterns, top return drivers, most-requested restocks, and VIPs with low CSAT.
- **Helpdesk hygiene.** Identify gaps in your tagging system, and clean up stale Rules and Macros.
- **AI Agent review.** Audit your Guidances and handover tickets, and draft and preview new instructions with confidence.
- **Ad-hoc reporting.** Create reports from plain-English prompts, like ticket volume trends by channel and intent, complete with key metrics and insights in under a minute.
- **Workflow automation:** Connect Gorgias to your stack and automate custom workflows, like flagging unhappy VIPs in Slack the second they write in.

## **What you need**
- **Your Gorgias account.** Any plan works. AI Agent is not required. Gorgias MCP is included at no extra cost.
- **Your own AI tool subscription.** Bring an active account with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-capable tool. You bring the LLM, we bring the connection.

title: 🛠️ Troubleshoot your Gorgias MCP connection issues | Gorgias
snippet:
Yayyy, [Gorgias MCP is finally here](https://community.gorgias.com/c/product-updates/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-gorgias)! But, for some reason, you can’t get it connected! Let’s try to find that reason — and, more importantly, the solution for it!
---
***1. Error: “This URL hosts an MCP endpoint”***
This indicates that the URL was opened in a browser, as if it was a website. You need to add it inside your AI client's connectors settings, since this is a connection endpoint. Find the instructions [here](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-the-gorgias-mcp-6310546#install-the-gorgias-mcp-on-claude-desktop).
---
***2. Error: “Authorization with MCP server failed”***
Check the name of the subdomain that you have added to the end of your MCP server URL. It should contain only the first part of your Gorgias URL, without any dots, quotation marks, or spaces.
For example, if your Gorgias login link is ***simply-gorgias****.gorgias.com*, then your MCP URL will be https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp?gorgias_subdomain=***simply-gorgias***
---
*** 3. No custom connector option in Claude app***
Check your Claude plan by clicking on your name in the bottom left corner, and then going to Settings → Billing.
a) If you’re on Enterprise or connected to a Team plan, reach out to the Owner (probably your manager or system admin), so they can first add it to your org accounts. Share [these instructions](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-the-gorgias-mcp-6310546#connect-to-team-and-enterprise-plans) with them.
b) If you’re an individual user with Free, Pro, or Max plan, type in your browser [claude.ai/customize/connectors](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors). Click the **"+"** button, and then select the** Add custom connector** option. Continue from step 3 in [these instructions](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-the-gorgias-mcp-6310546#connect-to-free-pro-and-max-plans).
---
If you continue having issues, please reach out to our team at support@gorgias.com
